description: Keep SwarmCLI chart versions in swarmcli-release.yaml up to date. Point `swarmcli charts apply -f` at the same file. Chart versions are plain SemVer (0.1.8) — the leading `v` belongs to the release git tag, not the chart version.

helmfile.description: swarmcli-release.yaml uses Helmfile's key names (repositories[].{name,url}, releases[].{name,chart,version}) precisely so Renovate's built-in helmfile manager can read it — no custom regex to maintain. The chart's registry is resolved from the `repositories` block in the file itself, so this preset hardcodes no URL and works for any chart repository you add.
